defects.defect: A number introduced by the round-2 rule-7b fix does not resolve to the table. The sentence reads 'The imputation medians run 0.714, 0.713 and 0.701 on the full cut for strict exclusion, softimpute and k-nearest-neighbour imputation'. Grouping tables/A2_T1_analysis_set_census_260917.csv by `imp` and taking the median of `pv_lobo3_f1_macro_mean` gives strict 0.713853, softimpute 0.712458, knn 0.701354. The softimpute median is 0.712 at three decimal places, not 0.713; 0.712458 does not round to 0.713 under any convention. The stated range of 0.013 is unaffected, because it is computed from the first and third values.
defects.required_fix: Change 0.713 to 0.712 in that sentence. Leave the range at 0.013 and leave the multiclass-only triple (0.698, 0.688, 0.648, range 0.050) alone — those four reproduce exactly.

defects.artifact: manuscript/FL_metric_classes_F1000_260917.md, Results, same section, the per-method median list (md line 167)
defects.defect: The round-2 rewrite of the per-method list states a bottom-of-the-ranking that the table contradicts. It says '...while 02_median_scaling (0.453, 0.571, 0.233, 9), 03_limma (0.480, 0.614, 0.154, 9), 26_xpn (0.529, 0.594, 0.255, 9), 16_fsqn_r (0.544, 0.621, 0.280, 9) and 13_fsmvn (0.537, 0.624, 0.240, 9) are last'. The three methods the sentence names as last — 26_xpn 0.5288, 13_fsmvn 0.5369 and 16_fsqn_r 0.5435 — all sit above those three, and 16_fsqn_r is eighth from the bottom of 31. The four quoted columns for each named method are themselves correct; it is the word 'are last' and the membership of the set that fail. None of the three omitted methods appears in the class-N election list in the preceding sentence, so 'last' cannot be read as restricted to the elected methods.
defects.required_fix: Either replace the five named methods with the five that actually sit lowest on the full cut (02_median_scaling 0.453/0.571/0.233/9, 03_limma 0.480/0.614/0.154/9, 07_pycombat 0.520/0.624/0.168/9, 21_harmonizr 0.521/0.576/0.124/9, 28_npn 0.523/0.606/0.296/9), or keep the present five and restate the claim as what is true of them — that each sits in the bottom third — naming the cut and the denominator.
